description: This header defines a function for unmounting a root filesystem image in the 'omi' namespace. It declares the function 'DoUnmount' which takes a filesystem mounter object, a container ID, and an error message string, returning an integer status code.

classes.name: ImageMounter
classes.description: A class representing a filesystem mounter, used by the DoUnmount function.

methods.name: DoUnmount
methods.description: Performs the unmount operation for a container's root filesystem, returning 0 on success and -1 on failure.
